how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.

foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: The new model, Fable 5.2, against today's Opus 5.5, judged blind on three past clothing problems and one code fix: Opus was better on the cuffs, equal on the neckband and nearly equal on the skin-through fix; Fable was better on the code fix (right on all real logs). Fable cost about three times as much and took twice as long. Switch any work to Fable?
sections.recommendation: No switch: Opus stays for the session and for clothing. Fable is used only as the 'one different method' after two failed tries on code or tool faults, and re-tested at the next model. The test overshot its 5% cap by about 3 points; your two Fable resets are untouched. No web link: the answer is this page.
options: No switch; Fable only for code after two failed tries (recommended)
